sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate is semantically faithful and deterministic validation is valid. It targets ship, uses the authoritative ship-owned strengthContinuityStatus with xsd:boolean, requires exactly one value, and enforces inclusive true without adding an unwarranted structural-connection existence requirement.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the ownership and coverage logic: strengthContinuityStatus has authoritative requiredOwner ship, so do not place it inside the structuralConnection node (a benchmarkEntity). Preserve the supplied boolean datatype and inclusive true value.
